defects.summary: The kimi none and disk rows' resultRef cites '§12 M-K6', but M-K6 is §9 of RESULTS_kimi_confinement.md (§12 is M-K9), so the shipped table points to the wrong section.
Decision 2 says each row's note carries the version 2.1.1, but the kimi web row's note does not name the version.

The shared 'unconfined' caveat now uses different words for codex too, which is outside the stories, and the standing's definition (the legend in runtime-capabilities.json and the CapabilityStanding.Unconfined doc) still says 'a shell is always there'; deviation 62 wrongly calls that legend codex-only.
The status line says 'deviations 50–62, not yet reviewed', but the list runs to 66 and deviations 62–66 come from a review.

S5.6.7 checks only that the tree under the row's scratch is gone (answered and cancelled arms) and does not check the row's scratch at all on the refused arm, so 'the row's scratch is gone' is only partly asserted.
Several deviations (50, 54, 55, 57, 61) tell the history of the work instead of a departure from the spec, which makes the list longer without adding information.
